note: Forbidden: acting on or displaying a zero-length capability. TestSoftverZeroValueCapabilityIsIgnored asserts RunCLIDecode of an empty value exits 1 with empty stdout, red if decodeSoftwareVersion accepted it and a version were shown. Its RunDecodeMode arm feeds the empty hex field invokePluginDecode writes for a zero-length value and asserts decoded unknown with no version; that arm is refused by the request parser before the decoder, so the CLI arm carries the discrimination. Negative: TestSoftverWellFormedCapabilityIsNotIgnored, the bare value zebgp is decoded and shown on both surfaces.
